import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Codechef {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        sc.nextLine();
        String input = sc.nextLine();
        
        int maxLength = 0;
        int innerCount = 0;
        int segmentStart = 0;
        
        int lastClose = input.lastIndexOf(')');
        for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
            if (input.charAt(i) == '(') {
                String segment = input.substring(segmentStart, i);
                processSegment(segment, (len) -> {
                    if (len > maxLength) maxLength = len;
                });
                
                int closeIndex = input.indexOf(')', i);
                if (closeIndex == -1) break;
                
                String inner = input.substring(i + 1, closeIndex);
                processInner(inner, (token) -> {
                    if (!token.isEmpty()) innerCount++;
                });
                
                segmentStart = closeIndex + 1;
                i = closeIndex;
            }
        }
        
        String finalSegment = input.substring(segmentStart);
        processSegment(finalSegment, (len) -> {
            if (len > maxLength) maxLength = len;
        });
        
        System.out.println(maxLength + " " + innerCount);
    }
    
    static void processSegment(String s, Consumer<Integer> consumer) {
        for (String token : s.split("_")) {
            consumer.accept(token.length());
        }
    }
    
    static void processInner(String s, Consumer<String> consumer) {
        for (String token : s.split("_")) {
            consumer.accept(token);
        }
    }
}
